name: offset_only
comment: Offset without limit: SQLite requires LIMIT before OFFSET, so the dialect renders its no-limit idiom (limit -1).

sqlite.sql: select id, role_name, created_at, updated_at from roles limit -1 offset @c0

sqlserver.sql: select [id], [role_name], [created_at], [updated_at] from [roles] order by (select null) offset @c0 rows
